title: Python REST APIs With Flask, Connexion, and SQLAlchemy – Part 2
description: Build a Flask REST API backed by a SQLite database. In part two of this series, you'll use SQLAlchemy and Marshmallow to persist and serialize data.
summary: Most modern web applications are powered by a REST API under the hood. That way, developers can separate the front-end code from the back-end logic, and users can interact with the interface dynamically.
takeaways: You’re also testing your API with Swagger UI API documentation that you’re building along the way.
In the first part , you used Flask and Connexion to create a REST API providing CRUD operations to an in-memory structure called PEOPLE .
You can interact with your application by leveraging the API documentation.
